name: Twist Five
description: Based on Pentago. The 6×6 board is made of four 3×3 plates. On your turn, place one marble in any empty hole, then turn any one plate a quarter turn, clockwise or counterclockwise. Get five of your marbles in a row (across, down or diagonally) to win. Five in a row right after placing wins at once, without a turn. If a turn gives both players five, or the board fills up with no five, the game is a draw. Turning a symmetric plate changes nothing, which matches the official optional turn early in the game.

ui_instructions: Tap a glowing hole to place your marble. Then tap one of the ↻ ↺ arrows around the board to turn that plate; on touch screens the first tap shows where the marbles will go and the second tap turns it. You can also select a plate and use the rotate buttons or R / Shift+R. Press Change marble to pick another hole first. Pinch or use the zoom buttons to zoom.

cases.name: Initial move
cases.description: Based on Pentago. The 6×6 board is made of four 3×3 plates. On your turn, place one marble in any empty hole, then turn any one plate a quarter turn, clockwise or counterclockwise. Get five of your marbles in a row (across, down or diagonally) to win. Five in a row right after placing wins at once, without a turn. If a turn gives both players five, or the board fills up with no five, the game is a draw. Turning a symmetric plate changes nothing, which matches the official optional turn early in the game.

cases.name: Intermediate move
cases.description: Based on Pentago. The 6×6 board is made of four 3×3 plates. On your turn, place one marble in any empty hole, then turn any one plate a quarter turn, clockwise or counterclockwise. Get five of your marbles in a row (across, down or diagonally) to win. Five in a row right after placing wins at once, without a turn. If a turn gives both players five, or the board fills up with no five, the game is a draw. Turning a symmetric plate changes nothing, which matches the official optional turn early in the game.

cases.name: Terminal move
cases.description: Based on Pentago. The 6×6 board is made of four 3×3 plates. On your turn, place one marble in any empty hole, then turn any one plate a quarter turn, clockwise or counterclockwise. Get five of your marbles in a row (across, down or diagonally) to win. Five in a row right after placing wins at once, without a turn. If a turn gives both players five, or the board fills up with no five, the game is a draw. Turning a symmetric plate changes nothing, which matches the official optional turn early in the game.

cases.name: Five in a row by placing, without a turn
cases.description: Based on Pentago. The 6×6 board is made of four 3×3 plates. On your turn, place one marble in any empty hole, then turn any one plate a quarter turn, clockwise or counterclockwise. Get five of your marbles in a row (across, down or diagonally) to win. Five in a row right after placing wins at once, without a turn. If a turn gives both players five, or the board fills up with no five, the game is a draw. Turning a symmetric plate changes nothing, which matches the official optional turn early in the game.

cases.name: Turning a plate completes five
cases.description: Based on Pentago. The 6×6 board is made of four 3×3 plates. On your turn, place one marble in any empty hole, then turn any one plate a quarter turn, clockwise or counterclockwise. Get five of your marbles in a row (across, down or diagonally) to win. Five in a row right after placing wins at once, without a turn. If a turn gives both players five, or the board fills up with no five, the game is a draw. Turning a symmetric plate changes nothing, which matches the official optional turn early in the game.

cases.name: A turn that gives both players five is a draw
cases.description: Based on Pentago. The 6×6 board is made of four 3×3 plates. On your turn, place one marble in any empty hole, then turn any one plate a quarter turn, clockwise or counterclockwise. Get five of your marbles in a row (across, down or diagonally) to win. Five in a row right after placing wins at once, without a turn. If a turn gives both players five, or the board fills up with no five, the game is a draw. Turning a symmetric plate changes nothing, which matches the official optional turn early in the game.

es.short_description: Basado en Pentago. El tablero de 6×6 tiene cuatro placas de 3×3.
